mapper.select: select a.apt_id as appointmentId, a.apt_candidate_id as candidateId, a.apt_position_id as positionId, a.apt_interviewer_id as interviewerId, a.apt_slot_id as slotId, a.apt_status as status, date_format(a.apt_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as startTime, date_format(a.apt_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as endTime, a.apt_meeting_url as meetingUrl, t.tal_user_id as candidateUserId, pos.pos_title as positionTitle from t_sch_appointment a left join t_tal t on t.tal_id = a.apt_candidate_id left join t_pos pos on pos.pos_id = a.apt_position_id where a.apt_id = #{appointmentId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_sch_slot (slt_interviewer_id, slt_position_id, slt_start_time, slt_end_time, slt_status) values (#{interviewerId}, #{positionId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status})
mapper.select: select slt_id from t_sch_slot where slt_interviewer_id = #{interviewerId} and slt_start_time = #{startTime} order by slt_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_sch_appointment (apt_candidate_id, apt_position_id, apt_interviewer_id, apt_slot_id, apt_start_time, apt_end_time, apt_meeting_url, apt_status) values (#{candidateId}, #{positionId}, #{interviewerId}, #{slotId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{meetingUrl}, 0)
mapper.select: select apt_id from t_sch_appointment where apt_candidate_id = #{candidateId} order by apt_id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update t_sch_appointment set apt_slot_id = #{slotId}, apt_start_time = #{startTime}, apt_end_time = #{endTime}, apt_status = 0, apt_updated_at = now() where apt_id = #{appointmentId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_msg (msg_receiver_id, msg_sender_id, msg_type, msg_title, msg_content, msg_is_read) values (#{receiverId}, 0, 1, #{title}, #{content}, 0)
